head.title: Start with the MAL Loans assistant
head.body: Tell the assistant what you need and it will point you to the right next step, including the right team when a person needs to help.

routeFinder.title: Use the assistant to find the right route.
routeFinder.body: The assistant can help with applications, repayments, existing loans and complaints. Direct phone, text and email routes remain available below.

assistant.title: MAL Loans assistant
assistant.body: Choose the topic closest to what you need, or start the assistant and type your own question. The assistant will take it one step at a time.

options.title: Start or continue an application
options.body: Get help choosing the application form or understanding the first quote steps.

options.title: You are struggling with repayments
options.body: Tell the assistant you need repayment support and it will show the right route quickly.

options.title: Update details or settle your loan
options.body: Ask about settlement figures, account updates or support for an existing loan.

options.title: You want to ask before applying
options.body: Check general eligibility, process or product questions before you apply.

options.title: Make or follow up a complaint
options.body: The assistant can point you to the complaints route and formal next steps.

directContacts.title: Call, text or email us directly
directContacts.body: If you already know the team you need, these contact routes are still available.

channels.title: Taking out a new loan?
channels.note: Please include your full name when emailing.

channels.title: Struggling with repayments?
channels.note: If you’re in difficulty, reach out — ignoring the problem only makes it worse.

channels.title: Update details or settle your loan?
channels.note: For settlements, include your full name and ‘SETTLEMENT’ in your message.

debtAdvice.title: Independent debt advice
debtAdvice.bodyHtml: Free, impartial help is available from StepChange on 0800 138 1111 and MoneyHelper on 0800 138 7777.
